narration: If your kid got a scholarship or didn't use their full 529, most parents think that money's basically stuck. But there's a $35,000 escape hatch most people have never heard of.
visual: 529 document icon springs in on dark background. Large '529' label with a dollar sign. Question mark pops up. Text overlay: '529 LEFTOVER? THERE'S A $35,000 ESCAPE HATCH'

narration: Old rule was brutal — 529 money had to go to education or you'd pay taxes plus a 10% penalty to pull it out. Billions of dollars sat trapped in accounts families couldn't touch.
visual: Light background. Money bag with padlock SVG. 'EDUCATION ONLY' and '10% PENALTY TO EXIT' warning text. 'BILLIONS TRAPPED' subtext.

narration: In 2024, SECURE 2.0 changed the game completely. Now you can roll unused 529 money straight into a Roth IRA — no taxes, no penalties, completely free. That's a big deal.
visual: Dark background. SECURE 2.0 scroll document. Animated arrow moving from '529' box to 'ROTH IRA' box. 'NO TAXES. NO PENALTIES. COMPLETELY FREE.' text overlay.

narration: Here are the three rules: number one, the 529 must be at least 15 years old. Number two, max $7,000 per year. Number three, the lifetime limit is $35,000 total.
visual: Light background. Three numbered rule cards spring in one by one — calendar icon '15-YEAR ACCOUNT MIN AGE', dollar icon '$7,000/YEAR MAX ROLLOVER', trophy icon '$35,000 LIFETIME LIMIT'.

narration: Here's why it matters: $35,000 in a Roth IRA at 25 grows to $533,000 by retirement — completely tax-free forever. That's one of the most powerful moves in the entire tax code.
visual: Dark background. Animated bar grows from a small '$35K AGE 25' bar to a tall green '$533,000 AGE 65' bar. Final callout: '$533,000 TAX-FREE FOREVER'.

narration: Nine out of ten 529 owners have no idea this rule even exists. If there's leftover money sitting in a 529, this is the move. Follow for more money moves they never taught you.
visual: Light background. Giant '90%' springs in. Animated '529 → ROTH IRA' arrow diagram. Dark card CTA: 'FOLLOW FOR MORE MONEY MOVES THEY NEVER TAUGHT YOU'.
